title: A Multi-Modal Robotic Framework for Physical GUI Interaction Testing
abstract: arXiv:2611.06939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated testing of mobile applications remains challenging when realistic user interactions must be reproduced and GUI behavior verified without relying on invasive mechanisms such as instrumentation or ADB-level control. Existing approaches, including DLD and R-DLD, detect data loss triggered by activity restarts but still depend on system-level access, which limits their applicability on real devices.   This doctoral research proposes RFNIT, a multi-modal, fully non-invasive robotic framework for physical GUI interaction testing on smartphones. RFNIT supports end-to-end automation by perceiving the device state through external sensing and executing physical interactions, enabling human-like actions while preserving reproducibility and execution accuracy.   The framework integrates a vision-based perception module, an LLM-driven reasoning agent, and a robotic actuator capable of performing touch, swipe, and typing gestures. Multimoda

translated_title: 一种用于物理GUI交互测试的多模态机器人框架
translated_abstract: 当需要重现真实的用户交互，并且在不依赖插桩或ADB级控制等侵入性机制的情况下验证GUI行为时，移动应用程序的自动化测试仍然具有挑战性。现有方法（包括DLD和R-DLD）能够检测由活动重启触发的数据丢失，但仍然依赖于系统级访问权限，这限制了它们在真实设备上的适用性。本博士研究提出了RFNIT，一个多模态、完全非侵入式的机器人框架，用于智能手机上的物理GUI交互测试。RFNIT通过外部感知来感知设备状态并执行物理交互，从而支持端到端自动化，在实现类人操作的同时保持可重复性和执行精度。该框架集成了基于视觉的感知模块、LLM驱动的推理代理以及能够执行触摸、滑动和打字手势的机器人执行器。
tldr: 该论文提出了RFNIT，一个多模态、完全非侵入式的机器人框架，通过视觉感知模块、LLM推理代理和机器人执行器，实现了无需系统级权限的智能手机GUI物理交互端到端自动化测试。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RFNIT, a multi-modal, fully non-invasive robotic framework that enables end-to-end automated physical GUI interaction testing on smartphones without system-level access, by integrating vision-based perception, an LLM-driven reasoning agent, and a robotic actuator.
